QUEST_BRIDGE.name: Clear the Old Bridge
QUEST_BRIDGE.desc: Bandits have seized the old bridge in the River Valley, south of the Dark Forest -- the only road to the Withered Crossroads. Clear out their camp.
QUEST_BRIDGE.descDone: The bandits are driven off and the old bridge is open again. Return to Aldric the Elder for your reward.

QUEST_COLOSSUS.name: The Heart of the Mountain
QUEST_COLOSSUS.desc: The ground trembles beneath the Mountain Pass. At its south end a switchback road leads down to the Mountain Depths and the Ember Caverns, and the tremors come from deeper still. Find the source and bring back proof.
QUEST_COLOSSUS.descDone: The Molten Colossus is dead. Return to Garrick the Hunter for your reward.

QUEST_FIND_HUNTERS.name: The Missing Hunters
QUEST_FIND_HUNTERS.desc: Our hunting party hasn't returned. Please find them.

QUEST_GRAVEROBBERS.name: The Missing Graverobber
QUEST_GRAVEROBBERS.desc: Three graverobbers camped just inside the Cursed Cemetery gate lost a companion in a hidden chamber beyond the Dark Crypt's great hall. Find him.
QUEST_GRAVEROBBERS.descDone: The Defiler is dead. Return to the graverobbers camped just inside the Cursed Cemetery gate.

QUEST_HAMMER.name: The Myth of the Ancient Hammer
QUEST_HAMMER.desc: The Frosthold Commander carried an Ancient Smithing Hammer. Bring it to Brom the Blacksmith.
QUEST_HAMMER.descReturn: You found an ancient smithing hammer. I wonder if our blacksmith can put it to good use.
QUEST_HAMMER.descDone: Brom can now socket your weapons and armor.

QUEST_KRAKEN.name: Hunt the Kraken
QUEST_KRAKEN.desc: Something with crackling tentacles lives in the flooded caves beneath the Lakeside Ruins. Descend through the Ancient Ruins and the Flooded Temple beneath Lakeside Ruins to reach the Sunken Depths. Hunt the Kraken at the far end of its bridge.
QUEST_KRAKEN.descDone: The Kraken is dead. Return to Garrick the Hunter for your reward.

QUEST_LEVIATHAN.name: The Poisoned Pool
QUEST_LEVIATHAN.desc: Something vast stirs in the poisoned pools of the Black Marsh, creeping ever closer to Mistfall. Hunt it down before it reaches the town. Its venom is deadly -- gear that resists poison will keep you standing.
QUEST_LEVIATHAN.descDone: The Leviathan is dead. Return to Garrick the Hunter for your reward.

QUEST_LIGHT_THE_WAY.name: Light the Way
QUEST_LIGHT_THE_WAY.desc: Bandits hold Lighthouse Tower and its beacon is dark -- no ship can dock without it. The tower stands on the west edge of Withered Crossroads (through River Valley). Climb to the rooftop and light the beacon.
QUEST_LIGHT_THE_WAY.descReturn: The beacon is lit. Return to Hobbs the Barkeeper inside the Tavern in Mistfall.

QUEST_MASTODON.name: The Icy Cellar
QUEST_MASTODON.desc: Enormous tracks lead into the Icy Cellar, west of the Icy Summit above the Mountain Pass. Follow them.
QUEST_MASTODON.descDone: The Woolly Mastodon is dead. Return to Garrick the Hunter for your reward.

QUEST_MINOTAUR.name: Hunt the Minotaur
QUEST_MINOTAUR.desc: A minotaur has made its lair in the Minotaur Cave, a maze of bone halls beside the River Valley road. Hunt it down and bring back what you find.
QUEST_MINOTAUR.descDone: The Minotaur is dead. Return to Garrick the Hunter.

QUEST_WRAITH.name: The Wraith Lord Unleashed
QUEST_WRAITH.desc: You accidentally released the Wraith Lord from its crypt. The Frosthold dwarves keep a special runestone at the top of their tower. Climb Frosthold Tower, retrieve it, and we can use it against the Wraith Lord.
QUEST_WRAITH.descDone: You took the runestone from the top of Frosthold Tower.

Q.name: Hunt the Minotaur
Q.desc: A minotaur has made its lair in the Minotaur Cave, a maze of bone halls beside the River Valley road. Hunt it down and bring back what you find.
Q.descDone: The Minotaur is dead. Return to Garrick the Hunter.

HUNTER_QUESTS.offer: "You saved us. Hunt the minotaur in the Minotaur Cave, beside the River Valley road?"
HUNTER_QUESTS.remind: "The minotaur waits in the great hall at the far end of the cave."
HUNTER_QUESTS.done: "A Heartstone... a witch in the Black Marsh may know what to do with it."

Q.descDone: The Kraken is dead. Return to Garrick the Hunter for your reward.

HUNTER_QUESTS.offer: "Something with crackling tentacles lives in the flooded caves beneath the Lakeside Ruins. Hunt it?"
HUNTER_QUESTS.remind: "The Kraken lurks in the Sunken Depths, beneath the Lakeside Ruins."
HUNTER_QUESTS.done: "You killed the Kraken! Take this ring -- it will keep the poison off you."

Q.desc: Something vast stirs in the poisoned pools of the Black Marsh, creeping ever closer to Mistfall. Hunt it down before it reaches the town. Its venom is deadly -- gear that resists poison will keep you standing.
Q.descDone: The Leviathan is dead. Return to Garrick the Hunter for your reward.

HUNTER_QUESTS.offer: "Since you defeated that Kraken, you should be able to take out a monster from the marsh pools in Black Marsh. Its poison eats through anything -- wear gear that resists poison. Please destroy it before it comes any closer to our town. Good luck!"
HUNTER_QUESTS.remind: "The beast lurks in the marsh pools of the Black Marsh. Wear gear that resists poison."
HUNTER_QUESTS.done: "You slew the Leviathan?! Take this -- you've earned it."

Q.name: The Icy Cellar
Q.desc: Enormous tracks lead into the Icy Cellar, west of the Icy Summit above the Mountain Pass. Follow them.
Q.descDone: The Woolly Mastodon is dead. Return to Garrick the Hunter for your reward.

HUNTER_QUESTS.offer: "Great tracks in the snow, leading to the Icy Cellar west of the Icy Summit. Will you follow them?"
HUNTER_QUESTS.remind: "The tracks lead to the Icy Cellar, west of the Icy Summit."
HUNTER_QUESTS.done: "You slew it?! Take this -- you've earned it."

Q.name: The Heart of the Mountain
Q.desc: The ground trembles beneath the Mountain Pass. At its south end a switchback road leads down to the Mountain Depths and the Ember Caverns, and the tremors come from deeper still. Find the source and bring back proof.
Q.descDone: The Molten Colossus is dead. Return to Garrick the Hunter for your reward.

HUNTER_QUESTS.offer: "The ground shakes at night. Something is stirring deep beneath the Mountain Pass -- take the southern road down, past the Ember Caverns. Bring me proof of what you find."
HUNTER_QUESTS.remind: "Down the Mountain Pass’ southern road, past the Ember Caverns. Deeper than that."
HUNTER_QUESTS.done: "You brought down the Molten Colossus?! A fragment of its shell... Take these -- you have more than earned them."
